name: discover/discover-card
title: DiscoverCard
summary: ONE card for every Discover page, with typed variants (article, event, circle, place) that share one anatomy: media, eyebrow, title (the primary link, covering the card), time, badge, figure, summary, meta, and actions ("Open in Mukoko").

props.name: variant
props.description: What the card shows; changes emphasis, never structure.

props.name: href
props.description: The item's page: the title link, which covers the card.

props.name: title
props.description: The item's name.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Source, category or region.

props.name: summary
props.description: Up to three lines.

props.name: image
props.description: An image URL; decorative by default (the title names the item). On top for article and event, a 48px round for circle and place.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text when the image says something the title does not.

props.name: initial
props.description: A monogram when there is no image (circle, place).

props.name: datetime
props.description: ISO 8601 for <time datetime>.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: The time as read: published (article) or starts (event, in bold).

props.name: place
props.description: Venue, town or region; the first meta item.

props.name: figure
props.description: A large figure on the right, e.g. "24°".

props.name: figureLabel
props.description: Under the figure, e.g. "Partly cloudy".

props.name: meta
props.description: More facts, in order.

props.name: badge
props.description: One short label, e.g. "Public", "Free".

props.name: badgeTone
props.description: neutral | brand | info | success | warning | danger (a server-filled shell may pass a placeholder).

props.name: appHref
props.description: An "Open in Mukoko" link (https: a universal link or a server redirect).

props.name: appLabel
props.description: The app link's text.

props.name: external
props.description: The title link leaves the site (a news source): rel="external noopener".

props.name: level
props.description: The title's heading level.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Replaces `image` and `initial`, e.g. a weather icon.

behaviour: Renders its own <li>, to sit in a ResultGrid.
The title is a heading containing the one primary link, stretched over the card (`after:inset-0`); other actions sit above it (`z-10`) and stay separately focusable.
The app link's accessible name includes the title ("Open in Mukoko: Harare Runners").
Badge tones are a `data-tone` attribute styled by classes; status tones use the status minerals, `brand` uses `--primary`.

Server-filled shells: every text prop is a plain string, and text that fills to "" hides itself (`empty:hidden`), so the component can be built once with `{{placeholders}}` and filled by a server (circles.mukoko.com's Rust Worker).

props.title: Harare Runners
props.summary: Saturday long runs from the Borrowdale track.

keyboard: Tab reaches the title link, then each action.
focus: The card shows the `--ring` ring while its title link has keyboard focus; actions show their own.
aria: Media and the monogram are decorative (alt="", aria-hidden) unless `imageAlt` says more; meaning is never colour alone (badges carry text).

theming.brandOverlay: The monogram and the `brand` badge tone tint with `--primary`; nothing else follows the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills its grid cell; images keep 16:9; text wraps and the summary clamps at three lines.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-card"
  uses discover-card-badge
  uses discover-card-meta
  a "Join in Mukoko" min_height 48
  when default shows a "Harare Runners"
  when article shows h3 "Rains arrive early in Mashonaland"
  when event shows time "Sat 24 Oct, 18:00"
  when place shows span "24°"
  when template shows a "{{name}}"
  when media shows a "7-day forecast"
end

checks.say: One primary link, in a heading.
The app link names the item.
An internal link has no rel.
The article image is decorative, lazy and sized.
A source link is marked external.
The place comes first in meta.
No image, no initial: no media.
The media slot replaces the image.
Actions sit above the stretched link.
